header.name: Diego Peyrano
header.role: Technical Lead | Software Engineer | Software Architecture

summary.p1: Systems Analyst graduated from ORT Argentina, Software Engineer and Technical Lead with 9+ years of experience in software development, systems analysis and building solutions for enterprise environments.
summary.p2: I have hands-on experience across multiple programming languages, paradigms and technology ecosystems, ranging from C, C++, Java and Smalltalk to Python, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript and Go. This broad foundation allows me to quickly adapt to new languages, frameworks and tools, selecting technologies based on the problem rather than being limited to a specific stack.
summary.p3: I am currently deepening my focus on software architecture and system design, with particular interest in maintainable and scalable systems, Hexagonal Architecture, modular design, design patterns, SOLID principles, system integration and technical decisions that support long-term software evolution.
summary.p4: My current work includes technologies such as .NET, C#, Angular, TypeScript and SQL, while maintaining experience across other ecosystems including React, Node.js, NestJS, Python and Django. I also incorporate modern development, automation and AI-assisted tools into my workflow for analysis, implementation, problem-solving and continuous improvement.
